name: Melka Kunture and Balchit: Archaeological and Palaeontological Sites in the Highland Area of Ethiopia
description: Melka Kunture and Balchit lie in the Upper Awash Valley of Ethiopia, roughly 50 kilometres south of Addis Ababa, at 2,000 to 2,200 metres above sea level. Layers of volcanic ash and river sediment have preserved stone tools, fossil bones and even footprints left by early humans, including Homo erectus, over two million years. It is a rare window onto how our ancestors lived in high mountains.
